faq1_a: Yes. Every training mode is free to start. When you run out of hearts, watch an ad or wait a bit for them to refill — or subscribe for unlimited hearts and no ads.
faq2_q: Can I start with no music background?
faq2_a: Yes. A 1-minute ear test sets your starting point, and reading music starts from a basics course.
faq3_q: What is the difference between absolute and relative pitch training?
faq3_a: Absolute pitch training means naming a note you hear without any reference. Relative pitch training means recognizing notes by their relationship (interval) to a reference note. Pick the one you want to build when you start, and switch any time in Settings — your learning path and progress stay the same.
faq4_q: Will I lose my progress if I switch phones?
faq4_a: Link an account in the app and you can sign in on your new device to pick up where you left off.
faq5_q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq5_a: Cancel any time from subscription management in the App Store or Google Play. You can also get there from the Shop screen in the app.
